summary_1line: As Rama stands exhausted before Ravana, the sage Agastya teaches him the Aditya Hridaya hymn to the Sun to restore strength and assure victory.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sage Agastya appears on the battlefield before the weary Rama and instructs him in the radiant Hymn to the Sun as Ravana waits in his chariot.
Rama stands in the war-torn field with folded hands, reciting the Aditya Hridaya while the blazing sun shines above him.
Ravana’s massive chariot drawn by galloping steeds rushes toward Rama as the final duel looms.
